newsitem.title: UK: Europe 1996/97 sugar output 30.2 mln tns-Man.
newsitem.headline: Europe 1996/97 sugar output 30.2 mln tns-Man.

text.p: European sugar production in the 1996/97 crop year totalled 30.2 million tonnes, according to International Trade House E D & F Man.
This compares with Man's figure of 26.6 million tonnes for European production in 1995/96.
"Higher crops across western and central Europe more than compensated for poor output once again in Russia and Ukraine," Man said in its Sugar Situation report.

Estimated 1996/97 Russian production was 1.836 million tonnes, compared with 2.241 million in the previous year. Ukraine's 1996/97 production was estimated at 2.935 million tonnes, compared with the previous year's 3.798 million.
Production in the EU rose to 17.983 million tonnes, compared with 16.963 million in 1995/96, including a jump for UK production to 1.608 million tonnes, from 1.322 million the previous year.
The western European total of 20.717 million tonnes (1995/96; 18.920) also includes a jump for Turkey to 2.024 million tonnes from the previous year's 1.495 million.
